question: What will be the maximum intraday value of the VIX over these biweekly periods in Q4 2026? (Nov 9 - Nov 20)

calls.reasoning: VIX closed 19.42 on Oct 30 after an intraday spike to its highest since April (sources disagree: 22.31 or 23.93) during a tech selloff; Nov 2 ~18.8. November VIX futures ~19.45 (curve roughly level with spot, elevated regime). Base rate: in 10-trading-day windows starting from a spot VIX near 18-20, the max intraday high is typically ~1.10-1.20x the starting level. The election (Nov 3) and jobs report (Nov 6) come before the window and could compress vol; CPI (Nov 10), Nvidia earnings (~Nov 17), VIX expiry (Nov 18) and Fed-hike repricing (~70% priced for Dec) fall inside it or hang over it, so the right tail stays fat. No matching prediction market found (none on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi).

- Base rate (rough, constructed): over 10-trading-day windows with a starting VIX ~18-20, the max intraday high is typically 1.10-1.20x the starting level; the right tail runs to 1.5x+ in shock windows (e.g. Aug 2024, Apr 2025).

The Nov 9-20 window (10 sessions) comes after the midterms and payrolls, which usually crush vol, and holds October CPI, the Nov VIX expiry and likely Nvidia earnings; no FOMC. Reference class: the max intraday high over 10 sessions starting a week out runs at about 1.03-1.10x spot at the median, right-skewed. calls.reconciliation: Factual disputes: the Oct 30 intraday high (22.31 vs 23.93) can't be settled without web access and barely matters for a Nov 9-20 window. The ~70% Fed-hike pricing comes from one source and is unverified, so it is treated only as right-tail risk. Judgment dispute: the max/spot multiplier (1.03-1.08 vs 1.10-1.20). The max-of-10-highs effect (+8-12% over a typical close) is offset by post-election and post-spike mean reversion toward ~17-18, so the reading lands near 1.05x of ~18.8. That is close to Runs 2 and 3; Run 1's 21 median ignores the vol crush. I keep Run 1's 1% upper-escape mass and use a width of 11.
